stations.title: Ailsa
stations.say: When did anyone ask for a stretcher?

stations.title: The old program
stations.text: Reads the whole winter before showing a line

stations.title: Your code
stations.gap: Nothing reads one line at a time

stations.title: The log
stations.note: The whole winter, line by line.

captions: At the radio desk, Ailsa needs the first call that asked for a stretcher this winter.
Today the program reads the whole winter's log first, and the laptop freezes.
You write generators that read one line at a time and stop once they have the answer.
Now the stretcher call comes up at once, and only the lines before it were read.
The whole winter's log opens in a moment, however long it grows.
